title: 七つの子 (Nanatsu no Ko)
description: A gentle children's song about a crow calling from the mountain because its seven beloved chicks are waiting in the old nest. Written by poet Noguchi Ujō in 1921, the song is famous for its warmth and the endearing image of a crow as a devoted parent. A staple of Japanese childhood.
license: Public Domain (lyrics: 野口雨情 1921, music: 本居長世 1921 — both authors deceased 50+ years)
